records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 把 Copilot 作為 AI 核心功能嵌入 Microsoft 365，藉由提升每位使用者的收入、擴大雲端訂閱座位，以及加大 AI 基礎建設投資，成為推動 Microsoft 365 商業策略成長的主要動力【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。

- 在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品組合中，Copilot 與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Power BI、Exchange、SharePoint、Teams、Security & Compliance 等服務共同構成 AI‑powered 的生產力平台，並被定位為提升溝通、協作、分析、安全與合規等多項 AI 商務生產力類別的關鍵工具【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  
- Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端營收因 Copilot（以及 Microsoft 365 E5）帶動每位使用者收入提升而成長 17%，同時座位數增長 6%，顯示 Copilot 正在推動新用戶與現有用戶的升級【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- Copilot 的使用量與座位需求促使成本結構變化，成本 of revenue 因支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的 AI 基礎建設投資上升 12%（增加 26 億美元（$2.6 billion））【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- 由於 Copilot 帶來的雲端服務需求，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端的毛利率亦因效率提升而略有上升，毛利總額增加 166 億美元（$16.6 billion）（+17%），顯示 Copilot 有助於提升整體盈利能力【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  

綜合來看，Microsoft 透過將 Copilot 深度整合至 Microsoft 365 各核心應用，利用 AI 功能提升使用者價值與每位使用者收入，同時在基礎設施與毛利結構上做出相應調整，以支撐其產品策略的持續成長。

Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過 Windows OEM 成長與 Windows 與 Azure、Microsoft 365 Copilot 的深度整合，直接提升雲端服務與 Copilot 相關使用率。  

- Windows OEM 在 2026 年的收入 **成長 5%**，儘管 More Personal Computing 整體收入因 Windows 與 Devices 合併下降 **1%**，此 OEM 成長顯示 Windows 設備仍在擴大部署，為雲端與 AI 服務提供終端入口【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- Azure 與其他雲端服務的收入在同一年 **增長 41%**，主要受全平台服務需求推動，這包括在 Windows 裝置上執行的雲端工作負載與 AI 應用【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入 **增長 17%**，其中每位使用者的收入提升主要來自 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 的座位與使用量增加，說明 Windows 使用者在日常工作中正採用 Copilot 來提升生產力【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- 為支援 Copilot 座位與使用量的成長，成本中 **AI 基礎設施投資上升**，顯示公司正加大對 Windows 與雲端 AI 服務的基礎建設投入【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #143】。  
- 微軟在其官方說明中指出，**Microsoft Cloud** 透過與 Windows 的整合，提供開放、降低成本、提升敏捷性的雲端平台，並以 AI 驅動的安全、合規與身份管理服務支援多雲環境，這正是 Windows 作為入口，將客戶引導至 Azure 與 Copilot 生態系的核心策略【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #49】。  

綜合上述，Windows OEM 的正向成長為 Windows 裝置的普及奠基，進而推動 Azure 雲端使用與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 的採用，形成 Windows → 雲端 → AI 服務的循環增長。

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads, including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing experiences that empower people to play, create, and interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. Our Future Opportunity

We are focused on helping customers use the breadth and depth of the Microsoft Cloud to get the most value out of their digital spend while leading the AI platform wave across our solution areas. We continue to develop complete, intelligent solutions for our customers that empower people to be productive and collaborate, while safeguarding businesses and simplifying IT management. records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟透過在 Microsoft 365 產品中加入 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 以及各種 AI 功能，直接把人工智慧嵌入 Office 各套應用程式中【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  

- 在 Microsoft 365 Commercial 版塊，Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Office、Windows、Enterprise Mobility + Security 等服務結合，形成一個 AI‑驅動的商務與生產力平台，讓使用者在 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等應用程式內即時取得 AI 生成的文字、圖表、分析與建議【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  
- 這些 AI 功能以「AI‑enabled tools、features、agentic scenarios」的形式加入核心產品，涵蓋通訊、協作、分析、資安與合規等多個商務生產力領域，並透過每位使用者的平均營收（ARPU）提升與安裝基礎的成長來驅動收入【MSFT_10K_2026.html, chunk #51】。  
- 同時，Microsoft 365 Commercial 的雲端服務亦包含 AI 消耗型服務（如 Azure AI），在「Intelligent Cloud」版塊中提供雲端與 AI 相關的計算資源，支援 Office 內的 AI 功能運作【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #44】。  

因此，微軟主要是透過 **Microsoft 365 Copilot** 以及在雲端平台上提供的 AI 計算資源，將 AI 功能直接整合到 Office 軟體的使用體驗中。
